jangwook.net Monthly Growth Report: 57% Organic Search, The Secret Behind 3.5x Growth

Transparency Statement: This report is based on actual GA4 data from November 21 to December 21, 2025 (31 days). We share both successes and failures honestly.

1. Executive Summary: 31 Days of Growth

1.1 Key Metrics Overview

Analysis Period: November 21 - December 21, 2025 (31 days) Previous Report: 45-Day Growth Report (October 7 - November 20)

Key Metric This Period Previous 45 Days Change Status
Total Users 2,647 750 +253% 🟢 Major Growth
Daily Avg Users 85.4/day 16.7/day +411% 🟢 Exceeds Target
Total Sessions 3,559 ~900 +295% 🟢 Major Growth
Total Pageviews 3,727 ~1,000 +273% 🟢 Major Growth
Organic Search Rate 56.5% 44.3% +12.2%p 🟢 Exceeds Target
Return Rate 16.0% 13.5% +2.5%p 🟢 Improved

1.2 Overall Assessment: 🟢 Explosive Growth

Traffic grew 3.5x in one month.

Key achievements in these 31 days:

🟢 Success Factors:

  • 56.5% Organic Search - Up 12%p from 44.3%, Google indexing optimization paying off
  • 85 daily average - 3-4x the target (20-30)
  • China market surge - 690 visitors (26% of total), now #2 country
  • New popular content - "Google Code Wiki Guide" 253 pageviews, 27% bounce rate
  • AI platform referrals - Consistent traffic from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini

🟡 Needs Improvement:

  • Direct traffic bounce rate 64% - Many first-page exits
  • Weekend traffic dip - 40-50% lower than weekdays
  • 16% return rate - Improved but still room for growth

Insight: AI platform referrals (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) totaling 100+ sessions are 3.7x higher than traditional social media (27 sessions). AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) strategy is working effectively.

3.2 Content Performance Insights

🏆 #1: Google Gemini RAG Tutorial

  • All language versions combined: 596 pageviews (16% of total)
  • 4+ minute average duration indicates deep learning content
  • Chinese version duration 16:49 - proves translation quality and content value

🚀 #2: Google Code Wiki Guide (New Star)

  • All languages combined: 445 pageviews
  • Korean version bounce rate 27.3% - lowest bounce rate
  • Rapidly rose to popularity after November 24 publication

📊 Multilingual Content Distribution:

  • Korean: 45%

  • English: 18%
  • Japanese: 15%

  • Stronger in Asian markets than English-speaking countries (US at 10.2%)

5.2 New vs Returning Users

Type Users Sessions Pageviews Duration Bounce Rate
🆕 New 2,590 (86.0%) 2,598 3,048 2:58 35.8%

Insight: New users have significantly lower bounce rate (35.8%) than returning users (60.1%). New visitors engage more deeply with content, while returning users tend to check specific information quickly.

6. Key Insights: 5 Truths from the Data

6.1 Organic Search is the Growth Engine

Data: 56.5% organic search (1,970 sessions from Google)

Analysis:

  • Up 12%p from previous 45 days (44.3%)
  • Google indexing optimization and consistent content publishing create compound effects
  • 3-5x industry average (10-20%) for a new blog

Recommendation: Expand content around popular keywords (Gemini RAG, MCP, Claude)

6.2 China is the New Growth Driver

Data: China 690 users (26% of total), #2 country

Analysis:

  • Rose to #2 market one month after adding Chinese support (Nov 17)
  • Claude Skills Guide, Gemini tutorial are popular

Recommendation: Strengthen content focused on Chinese developer interests (AI tools, automation)

6.3 AI Platforms are New Referral Channels

Data: ChatGPT(88) + Perplexity(32) + Gemini(16) = 136 sessions

Analysis:

  • 5x traditional social media (27 sessions)
  • AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) strategy working effectively

Recommendation: Expand structured Q&A format, clear definitions, step-by-step guide content

6.4 Content Quality Proven by Duration

Data: Chinese Gemini tutorial average duration 21:06

Analysis:

  • Top landing pages average 4-5 minute duration
  • Readers genuinely engaging with in-depth tutorial content
  • Translation quality and technical accuracy create value

Recommendation: Plan deep tutorial series with 15-20 minute reading time

6.5 Homepage Needs Urgent Improvement

Data: Homepage bounce rate 78.8%, duration 1:08

Analysis:

  • Search-acquired users exit without exploring after landing
  • Lack of guidance from homepage to interesting content
  • "About" page (15.4% bounce rate) is effective in contrast

Recommendation: Add popular content section and recommended post cards to homepage

🟢 Strategic (Q1 2026)

Action Goal Timeline

AI tools integrated tutorial series Complete 5 part series February

8. Conclusion: 75 Days of Journey

It's been 75 days since starting this blog.

  • October 6: Blog launch, 34 visitors on day one
  • November 20: 45-day report, 750 cumulative visitors, 16/day
  • December 21: This report, 2,600 visitors, 85/day

Beyond the Numbers:

2,600 people from 53 countries visited this blog and spent an average of 3 minutes each. AI tools are citing my articles, and someone in China spent 21 minutes reading a tutorial.

Data doesn't lie. Write consistently, grow consistently.

See you in the next report with even better numbers.

Was this report helpful? I hope this transparent data helps those starting or growing their blogs. Questions and feedback are always welcome.
